title: Site Owner & Content Curator
bio: Hey, I'm Lucahman — the one who runs this whole circus. Been curating Malay adult content since 2023. I personally review every video that goes up, handle the technical side, and make sure the site stays running smooth. When I'm not here, I'm probably watching old P. Ramlee movies or messing around with new tech. I believe everyone deserves a judgment-free space to explore their desires. Hit me up if you've got suggestions, complaints, or just wanna chat about your favourite content.
catchphrase: No judgment here — we're all human.

title: Community Support & Content Reviewer
bio: Assalamualaikum! I'm Siti, your go-to person for anything community-related. I review flagged content, handle user reports, and make sure everyone's following the rules. I've been doing this for about a year now and I genuinely love connecting with our users. Outside of work, I'm a huge fan of romantic dramas and I run a small online bakery. Don't judge my dual life okay haha. If something's bothering you about a video or you just need someone to talk to, I'm here.
catchphrase: Your comfort matters. I'm just a message away.

title: Tech Support & Video Quality Lead
bio: Yo, I'm Amin. I make sure your videos load fast, look crisp, and don't buffer at the worst moment. I handle the encoding pipeline, thumbnail generation, and all the backend stuff. Been in IT for 6 years, doing adult streaming for 2. I'm also the guy to talk to if you find broken links or playback issues. When I'm not working, I'm gaming (Valorant, Dota 2), lifting weights, or watching anime. I keep it 100% real with everyone — if something's broken, I'll tell you straight up and fix it.
catchphrase: If it's broken, I'll fix it. If it can't be fixed, I'll build a new one.

title: User Experience & Content Listener
bio: Hai, I'm Maya! I'm here to listen — literally. If you've got feelings about something you watched, something that made you uncomfortable, or something you absolutely loved, I want to hear it. I'm the soft landing spot for all the stuff you might not want to say to anyone else. I believe everybody deserves to be heard without judgment. I'm also studying psychology part-time, so I guess you could say I'm professionally nosy haha. I love indie music, photography, and long conversations about nothing and everything.
catchphrase: Whatever's on your mind, I'm here to listen. No filter needed.

title: Intern — Community Engagement
bio: Hello! I'm Qistina Dayana, the newest member of the team. I'm here as an intern to learn the ropes of community engagement and content moderation. I assist with user inquiries, help review flagged content, and make sure everyone feels heard. I'm studying mass communications at university and this is my first hands-on experience in the adult content space — and honestly, it's been eye-opening! I believe in respectful, honest communication and I'm always eager to help. Don't be shy to reach out, I don't bite! Well, unless you ask nicely hehe.
catchphrase: New here but ready to help! Talk to me, I'm friendly I promise.
